scope: embedded scenario resource failure isolation from Portal chat workspace

commands.assertions: Four tests pass, including a real dispatched iframe error event. The frame renders a local unavailable state and the sibling chat draft input remains usable.

assertions: A loaded iframe resource error transitions only the frame to an unavailable state.
The surrounding workspace retains its chat input after the frame failure.
Retry remains local to the frame and does not throw into the Portal tree.
limitations: This validates the browser component failure boundary in the current Portal test environment; a separate remote-process crash receipt is not available.
